learning.input_contract: Genus categorical, value finite signed effect; simulation seed 7001, 20 taxa. Counts are observation counts, not inferred significance.
learning.transform: Estimate within-taxon density; count observed value > 0 or <= 0. Display negative count to the left, positive count to the right; label count magnitude.
learning.join_order: Create one Genus factor with explicit levels; both layers consume identical levels. Do not sort each panel separately.
learning.package_roles: ggridges::geom_density_ridges_gradient supplies continuous sign-based density fill; ggplot2::geom_col supplies signed counts; patchwork::plot_layout aligns rows.
learning.layout_rules: 203 by 180 mm; 3:2 data panel width ratio; white background; Arial; left panel owns taxon labels. Count zero and sign palette share meaning across panels.
learning.failure_modes: Reject nonfinite values; account for zero observations; density needs sufficient observations. Labels or unbalanced counts beyond fixed limits require adaptive width/range and fresh review.

stress_variants: long taxon labels: enlarge label slot before reducing font
8/40 taxa: adapt height and use same factor levels
all-negative taxon: retain zero-count positive category
independent_transfer_status: not-tested; current run uses an existing script
